task_statement: drive the hero to each declared minimap target in order and stop, on one device session and one transition store, when the perception is reliable and when it is not
declared_goal_source: the versioned navigation contract bound by policy_bundle_sha256; a task condition, not human intent
rule_baseline: the frozen geometry rule of the navigation contract, replayed on the same scenario

signals.name: hero_position
signals.derivation: frozen green-ring cue on the minimap view of the FramePacket

signals.name: hero_motion
signals.derivation: largest inter-observation change region inside the minimap interior

signals.name: action_dispatch
signals.derivation: the joystick direction actually passed to set_direction at dispatch time

signals.name: terminal
signals.derivation: arrival when the goal distance is within the declared tolerance for every target in order

not_independent: terminal against its own rule outcome
independence.forbidden: the same unvalidated detector must not both author a reward and prove its own accuracy
independence.duplication_guard: if the second position derivation agrees with the recorded signal exactly on most steps it is a duplicate of that signal, not an independent reference, and the audit must fail

stop_conditions: the second derivation duplicates the recorded signal instead of checking it
position coverage below the frozen gate
reference agreement below the frozen gate
action agreement below the frozen gate
terminal agreement below the frozen gate
any reward component whose only reference is the same unvalidated detector
